answer: Divergent-Response Challenge. Each identity must answer a fresh random challenge whose input is drawn from a shared knoll of public entropy, and responses are scored against a per-round inlet of accepted variants. A genuine agent diverges into a distinct valid answer; a clone, sharing one policy, emits the same output and is flagged by collision. Passing requires either external compute to re-derive a unique response per clone (cost scales linearly with fleet size) or risking detection. Attacker pays per-identity recomputation plus a lotus of failed rounds,
